abort.expired: This request expired or was replaced by a newer one: pair again from the watch.
abort.pair_from_watch:
Watches are added from their app. In the Zepp app, enter `{url}` in the settings of the Home Assistant mini app, then touch Pair on the watch: it shows up here as discovered, with a code to enter.

The watch needs `zepp:` in `configuration.yaml` to be heard before its first pairing.

create_entry.default: The watch got its key by itself. Choose what it shows in the settings of the watch app on the phone, or in the options of the integration.

error.invalid_code: Not the code the watch shows.

data_description.code: The six digits {name} shows. A request without this code cannot be approved.

confirm.description: {name} asks to control Home Assistant from the watch.

data_description.areas: These areas come first, in this order; the others follow by name.
data_description.entities: A page per area, in this order. They can also be chosen in the settings of the watch app, among the entities exposed to Assist.
data_description.favorites: The first page of the watch, in this order.
data_description.pipeline: Answers the voice messages. The preferred pipeline if empty.
